name: Momentum Group
evidence: Momentum Group's own contact page gives its Centurion head office as 268 West Avenue, Centurion, 0157, with telephone (012) 671 8911, and lists further offices in Sandton, Bellville and Cornubia.
note_append: The website is corrected from momentummetropolitan.co.za to momentumgroupltd.co.za, the domain the group's own pages are served from; the former name Momentum Metropolitan Holdings is retained as an alias rather than dropped. Its own About us page states that the group operates through four brands - Momentum, Metropolitan, Guardrisk and Eris Property Group - and that Momentum itself was established in 1966.

name: Vodacom
evidence: Vodacom Group's own About us page states that the Group, including Safaricom, serves 230 million customers, has mobile networks covering a population of 596 million people, operates in the DRC, Egypt, Ethiopia, Kenya, Lesotho, Mozambique and Tanzania alongside South Africa, and is majority-owned by Vodafone with a 65.1% holding.
note_append: The group reports 230 million customers including Safaricom, and mobile networks covering a population of 596 million. Customer counts are recorded as context, not as a scale measure, because headcount-based scale would misdescribe a subscriber business. Vodafone holds 65.1% of the group, as Vodacom itself states.
